The $60 million, 16-acre terminal sits along the Delaware River in Tinicum Township, right near the airport. Norwegian Cruise Line's ships — the Norwegian Jewel and Norwegian Pearl — sail from here to Bermuda, the Caribbean, the Bahamas, New England, and Canada, with 40+ voyages planned through at least April 2028. Bermuda cruises run from spring through summer (the 7-day itinerary includes a stop in Charleston, SC, and an overnight stay at Bermuda's Royal Naval Dockyard), before the schedule shifts to New England and Quebec in the fall. The terminal welcomed its first 2,500 passengers at the grand opening. Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings remains the port's exclusive cruise operator through a seven-year agreement running through March 2033, with the project projected to support 2,185 direct and indirect jobs.
